name: Nathan Sosa

bio.statement: His official page says he chairs the House Committee on Commerce and Consumer Protection.
bio.excerpt: I serve as chair of the House Committee on Commerce and Consumer Protection

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature

bio.statement: His official page says he served four years on the Oregon Government Ethics Commission and chaired it in 2020.
bio.excerpt: I also served for four years on the Oregon Government Ethics Commission and was chair of the commission in 2020.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature

bio.statement: Ballotpedia says Sosa began working as an attorney in 2009.
bio.excerpt: Sosa began working as an attorney in 2009.

source.publisher: Ballotpedia

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Sosa lists his occupation as state representative, small business owner and attorney.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Representative, Small Business Owner, Attorney Occupational Background: Attorney

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 51

bio.statement: Sosa lists a law degree and a bachelor's degree in history from UNLV.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: Law degree and bachelor’s degree in history, UNLV

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: KATU reports Sosa supported a 2025 bill (HB 2561) on out-of-state lender interest rates, describing it as closing a loophole.
positions.excerpt: closing the loophole that has allowed these out-of-state lenders

source.publisher: KATU

positions.statement: Sosa says he has championed bills on affordability for consumer loans and utility rates, and wants to continue with auto and home insurance and retail pricing.
positions.excerpt: I have championed bills on affordability for consumer loans and utility rates. Now I want to continue this work on affordability for auto / home insurance and retail pricing.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: Sosa says he has devoted his career to consumer protection and wants to hold insurance companies accountable and stop crypto scams.
positions.excerpt: I have devoted my career to consumer protection. Now I want to stop crypto scams and hold insurance companies accountable if they treat people unfairly.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: Sosa says his family has experienced ever-rising rents and that he wants to protect people from needless eviction lawsuits.
positions.excerpt: My family has experienced the burden of ever-rising rents and the feeling that home ownership is out of reach. Now I want to protect people from needless eviction lawsuits.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 51

positions.statement: Sosa says he is a small business owner and wants to cut regulatory red tape so small businesses can grow.
positions.excerpt: I am a small business owner and spent years as a volunteer ambassador with the Washington County Chamber. Now I want to cut regulatory red tape to make it easier for small businesses to grow and thrive.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 51

gaps: Few sourced positions: campaign site nathansosa.com (policy priorities) not usable because the domain is not linked from an official page or T3 source consulted

collection_notes: Incumbent per House roster (appointed to the seat per Banks Post/Washington County; appointment details not itemized). Inventory consistent. nathansosa.com content was fetched (T2) but its domain is only evidenced via an email address on Ballotpedia, so website_url left null; a reviewer may add it if verified. KATU article's HB 2561 date is the article date 2025-03-01; it does not state sponsorship. Pamphlet statement: SOS Washington edition p. 51 (same text in other editions).
